description: The week's board for every NFL game: consensus spread and total, what each half point is worth when shopping (the price at -4, -3.5, -2.5 that matches the consensus at -110, and how often the game lands on 3 or 7), rest days and travel, a penalty-discipline edge, the National Weather Service forecast for open-air stadiums inside 7 days, and every betting angle that applies to the game, each backtested with its record, win rate and a verdict of holds up, noise, or no edge. Ends with a short ranked list of games worth a look and why. For 'what should I look at this week', 'Thanksgiving games', 'any edges on the slate', 'week 13 board', 'Sunday's games'. Lines are the consensus number and move until kickoff.

week.description: NFL week number, or 'next' (default: the next week with unplayed games).

name: slate_scan
title: This week's NFL slate: what's worth a look, game by game
